failedAttempts.disposition: Reviewer script fault, not app behavior. getByRole("combobox") matched both the Default locale select and the Default timezone combobox, and the Playwright expect timeout was not applied. Later steps cascaded from that fault. The instance was then reused for phases B0 to B2, which do not need a fresh first-account form (B0 signs in to the Administrator that attempt 1 created). Phase A was rerun in full on a new lab.
